message.content:
It sounds like you've encountered a change in behavior related to banners with underlined text in Open WebUI, and now these banners display correctly instead of failing to render. To troubleshoot and verify the fix, you can follow these steps:

### 1. Check for Recent Updates
First, verify if there were any recent updates or patches to Open WebUI that addressed issues with banner rendering. Review the changelog or release notes to see if there were any updates related to banner rendering or text formatting.

### 2. Inspect the Code Changes
If you have access to the source code, look at the changes made in the most recent commits. Focus on any modifications related to HTML, CSS, or JavaScript files that deal with banner rendering or text styling.

### 3. Browser Console
Open your browser's developer tools and check the console for any errors or warnings when displaying banners with underlined text. This can help identify if the issue has been resolved or if there are new errors to address.

### 4. CSS and HTML
Ensure that the CSS rules for banners are correctly handling underlined text. Check if there are any specific styles applied to banners or text within banners that might interfere with underlining.

### 5. JavaScript Functionality
If there is JavaScript involved in rendering the banners, check if any functions have been updated to handle underlined text properly. Look for any JavaScript errors in the console related to banner rendering.

### 6. Testing
Create a test case where you intentionally include underlined text in a banner and observe how it is rendered. Make sure to test different types of banners and edge cases to ensure that the fix is comprehensive.

### 7. User Feedback
If you are developing an application, gather feedback from users who encountered this issue before to confirm if the problem is fully resolved for them as well.

### 8. Documentation
Update the documentation or help files to reflect any changes made to banner rendering, especially regarding underlined text.

By following these steps, you should be able to confirm whether the issue with banner rendering has been resolved and ensure that the fix is working as intended across different scenarios.
